674.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and fluffy omurice, which features a rich Hayashi sauce and cheese, and appreciate the affordable lunch sets that include a salad and drink. Other reviews mention the staff can be impolite and the omurice can be served with plain rice.
674.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、濃厚なハヤシソースとチーズが特徴の、美味しくてふわふわなオムライスが高く評価されています。サラダとドリンクが付いた手頃な価格のランチセットも好評のようです。 一方で、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないという意見や、オムライスが白米で提供されることがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: I ordered omurice with Hayashi topping. When the plate arrives it just smells like bitter chocolate, and it also tastes the same. I could not eat more then 2 bites, it's disgusting and doesn't taste good at all. The atmosphere is not bad, but the terrible omurice and high price absolutely ruined my experience. This was the first and also last time I visit this place.

11:30入店。 ランチの予約はやってないので10分ほど前からお店の入り口で待機していました。 開店して間もなく座席の7割が埋まっていたので、早めに入って良かったです。 今日はチーズインオムハヤシを注文。10分も待たず配膳されました。 前回のキラキラチーズオムライスもチーズと卵の見た目・コクと濃厚な味が素晴らしかったですが、今回のチーズインオムハヤシも負けず劣らず美味しかったです。（チーズorハヤシ、どちらも捨てがたい…） オムライスの量もそれなりにあり、大盛りではなくとも結構お腹いっぱいになりました。 値段もオムライスの味・量を考えるとリーズナブルに思います。 今回2回目の来店になりますが、雰囲気・店員の対応はとても良いので、また近いうちに伺いたいです。 次はオムカレー（大盛り？）食べたいですね！ 蛇足ですが、キラキラチーズオムライスはホントにチーズがキラキラしてます！

おすすめ度：★★★★★ 隠れ家感のある洋食店。 平日のランチタイムでも満席に近いほどの人気ぶり。 ここで提供されるオムライスは、 「おいしい卵を使っているので、ケチャップは伸ばさず、オムレツは開かない」 という、ふわふわ食感をそのまま楽しむのが当店のスタイル ナイフを入れずに味わう、 卵本来のやさしい甘みと、とろける食感が印象的でした さらに、 「オムスタグラマーが選ぶオムライスグランプリ2020」で全国1位に選ばれた実力店！ 焼きカマンベールオムハヤシは、 濃厚なハヤシソースとチーズのコクが重なり、満足度の高い一皿 今回はランチ利用でしたが、 夜の雰囲気も気になるお店です！ ー•ー•ー•ー•ーー•ー•ー•ー•ーー•ー•ー 【注文したメニュー】 ・焼きカマンベールオムハヤシセット 2,150円 （ランチセット：ドリンク付き） ・オムライス 1,050円 （スープ、ミニサラダ、ドリンク付き）

675.a: Takachiho Gorge, Mukoyama, Takachiho, Nishiusuki District, Miyazaki 882-1103, Japan
675.aj: 〒882-1103 宮崎県西臼杵郡高千穂町向山高千穂峡
catj: ハイキング コース
675.ed: River canyon with waterfalls over sheer basalt cliffs, viewable from rented boats & a paved path.
675.edj: 景勝地の峡谷。玄武岩の断崖から注ぐ滝が有名で、貸しボートや遊歩道から観賞できる。

rv.t: This is an amazing place to visit. We found driving to be easier than utilizing public transportation. There are several parking areas available, and shuttle vans operate between each parking lot, so please make a note of your parking number. I have attached the timetable and shuttle route here, should it be helpful to you at any point. As we were traveling with a child and an elder, the shuttle van greatly assisted…

Truly marvelous place..!! First of all, to get the boat reservation, you must have to book the boats online 2 weeks prior to your trip, because they sold out within 10 minutes (there are only 18 boats, per slot). Ticket sale opens at 9:00am, two weeks before the target date in the official website. Highly recommend to have a backup person to proceed with the booking, because sometimes website freezes due to obvious…

1000 yen for parking but the gorge is so unique and so interesting that's it's very worth it. We did not get to kayak because of heavy rains. But seeing the lively rapids and waterfalls was amazing. Fairly popular with tourists like us.

676.a: Japan, 〒108-0071 Tokyo, Minato City, Shirokanedai, 2 Chome−11−6 とんかつ大慎
676.aj: 〒108-0071 東京都港区白金台２丁目１１−６ とんかつ大慎

rv.t: Stumbled upon this place and it was amazing. The 2 gentleman serving and cooking didn’t speak much English but were really friendly and helpful with English menu available. We had pork tonkatsu set and the prawn and scallop set. Both were delicious. The pork was really juicy and tender. Highly recommend.

Really good place if you want to eat good Tonkatsu ! The meat is really good, juicy and well cooked. You've choice between loin or filet and each between 100g to 250g. Each Tonkatsu is served with rice, miso soup, a tofu and some pickles! Inside the atmosphere is great and all is new and modern. The owner are very friendly and english menu available if needed. I recommend this place!

On our last night of our trip, we were craving tonkatsu. I didnt want to find a chain but truly local place. We stumbled upon this place and it did not disappoint. The owners were kind and willing to serve anyone. The food was amazing and the two owners just seemed to be having fun running their business. Highly recommend this place. They had an English menu. It's a small place so keep your voices down and just…

676.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

677.a: Japan, 〒101-0044 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Kajicho, 2 Chome−13−11 Happiness is KATSUDON Kanda, JR神田駅 高架下
677.aj: 〒101-0044 東京都千代田区鍛冶町２丁目１３−１１ #カツ丼は人を幸せにする 神田店 JR神田駅 高架下
677.ed: Diners say this restaurant's katsudon features crispy cutlets, juicy meat, and fluffy eggs with a well-balanced sauce, and they offer a vegetarian soybean hamburger don. They also highlight the friendly and efficient staff, reasonable prices, and cozy atmosphere. Some reviews mention ordering can be difficult.
677.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、カツ丼のサクサクとしたカツ、ジューシーな肉、ふわふわの卵、そしてバランスの取れたタレが高く評価されています。また、ベジタリアン向けに大豆ハンバーグ丼も提供しているようです。気の利くスタッフの対応、手頃な価格、居心地の良い雰囲気も好評です。 一方で、注文が難しいという声も一部で聞かれます。

rv.t: Small 7 seater cozy restaurant. Crispy and tender pork katsu with balanced amounts of fats. Egg was silky. Sauce wasn't too sweet. Simple menu and very affordable. Unplanned visit but will definitely come back again.

Incredible little restaurant. Had the best Katsundon I've ever had here. Its located next to Kanda station and definitely worth a visit if you're in the area. I ordered the chicken which was perfectly cooked and juicy. Service was very friendly and quick. Ordering is via a QR code once inside with English menu available
This was my favourite place to eat when I stayed in Kanda. The food is amazing. The service is quick and friendly and the prices are reasonable. If I ever come back to Japan I will definetly be back.

677.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

678.a: Wagyu Ramen Goku, 宮益坂東豊エステート 101 1 Chome-12-12 Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0002, Japan
678.aj: 〒150-0002 東京都渋谷区渋谷１丁目１２−１２ 宮益坂東豊エステート 101 和牛らーめん 極
678.ed: Diners like this ramen restaurant's rich and flavorful wagyu ramen, featuring tender beef and a creamy broth. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the cozy, clean atmosphere. Guests mention the friendly and attentive staff, noting the easy-to-use English ordering kiosk.
678.edj: このラーメン店を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、和牛ラーメンの濃厚で風味豊かな味わいが特に高く評価されています。柔らかい和牛とクリーミーなスープが特徴のようです。また、手頃な価格と居心地の良い清潔な店内も好評です。親切で気の利くスタッフについての言及も多く、英語対応の券売機が使いやすいという声もあります。

rv.t: A unique ramen experience featuring rich wagyu flavors. The broth was creamy and flavorful, and the thin slices of wagyu beef added a premium touch. I especially enjoyed the spicy version, which had a nice kick without overpowering the soup. The restaurant was clean, the staff were friendly, and watching the ramen being prepared right in front of the counter was fun. Prices are a bit higher than typical ramen shops…

No queue at 2pm, which was a nice surprise for a Sunday. Ordered from the standard ticket machine and got the Chef’s Special Wagyu Ramen, one regular and one with yuzu. Fun watching one of the chefs prepare the bowls right in front of us. The broth was the highlight: deep umami, not salty at all, and creamy in a way I couldn’t quite place, didn’t feel heavy though. The beef came three ways: a few slices of wagyu…

An absolute amazing gem to have found! It’s tucked away past the main part of Shibuya. It’s small space, fairly quiet and a wonderful vibe. The staff is friendly and prices are higher but the quality of meat & broth makes it worth every cent. You order from a touch screen machine (you can change the language) and pay (cash & card accepted) then they seat you. The broth is a deep bone broth from the Wagyu they have…

678.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

679.a: marble Kuramae, トマック第３ビル 1F 4 Chome-1-4 Kuramae, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0051, Japan
679.aj: 〒111-0051 東京都台東区蔵前４丁目１−４ トマック第３ビル 1F marble 蔵前
679.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and creamy cheesecakes, especially the seasonal and unique flavors, as well as the rich coffee and firm pudding. They also highlight the spacious, calm, and stylish atmosphere, which is welcoming for both solo visitors and those with pets. Some reviews mention popular items can be sold out.
679.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくてクリーミーなチーズケーキ、特に季節限定のユニークな味が評価されています。また、コクのあるコーヒーとしっかりとしたプリンも人気です。広々としていて落ち着いたおしゃれな雰囲気も特徴で、一人でもペット同伴でも過ごしやすいという声が多くあります。 人気のメニューは売り切れていることがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Really nice cafe in Kuramae! The interior is very modern, warm and welcoming and the coffee (hot latte & iced americano) tasted great! Nice and strong🤎 We tried the black tea cheesecake and the lemon cheesecake, which were both delicious, very creamy, but the lemon one stood out the most for us!

I ordered an americano, pistachio cheesecake, milk tea cheesecake, and houjicha latte. Basque cheesecakes were super creamy and rich. The milk tea flavor was really flavorful and balanced. The pistachio was mid. It just tasted like cream and not much pistachio. Most places that offer pistachio is a hit or miss in that sense in my opinion. The houjicha latte was amazing. I like that the tea flavor was strong. It…

The cafe is on a little side street so it’s nice & quiet. Perfect place for a cafe date, reading a book, or unplugging for a sec (they don’t have wifi). There’s plenty of seating, the music is good, & the staff is very friendly of course. The menu is small but the quality & prices are great. Highly recommend!

680.a: Chion's house, 735-1 Fuchaku, Onna, Kunigami District, Okinawa 904-0413, Japan
680.aj: 〒904-0413 沖縄県国頭郡恩納村冨着７３５−１ 土と音の旅 チオンの家

rv.t: Hard to believe why not much people mention this hotel, this is a truly amazing hotel. The fairy tales house is deco up to the core, every single details. The setup is so warm, owner was so welcoming, it’s the best hotel in Okinawa yet. Consider we did over 150 hotel rooms tours in 2 years. I know! It’s so good everyone kept it as hidden gem!

10000% worth the stay. This home feels straight out of a studio ghibli movie. I couldn’t get enough of all the details and thoughtfulness put into the home. It’s so cozy and comfortable. Hearing and seeing the ocean was so calming. I felt like a reconnected with my inner child again, harvesting flowers, feeding the fish, and reading in the nook. I’m so happy I booked this place for my birthday and I can’t wait to…

Worth it to stay !!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ It was indeed a great experience every details of the Chion’s house was really amazing🤩 it's like you're in another world, so beautiful and unique. The owner is also amazing for maintaining the beauty and cleanliness of the surroundings perfect for family bonding and also for couples at night so romantic .The cutie lamps & lights, I surely you will love it 🥰 it also have projector 📽️…

681.a: Miyakojima Botanical Garden, Higashinakasonezoe-1166-286 Hirara, Miyakojima, Okinawa 906-0011, Japan
681.aj: 〒906-0011 沖縄県宮古島市平良東仲宗根添１１６６−２８６ 宮古島市熱帯植物園
681.edj: 沖縄各島に原生する植物に加え、ハワイ、台湾、東南アジアの植物園から集めた植物を生育している。複数のウォーキングコースがある。

rv.t: Lovely place, the Botanical Garden has free entry. It is a nice, relaxing place, nothing too exciting, just beautiful traditional garden with pond, trails around the garden, flowers and vegetation. Also found many underground tunnels and bunkers reminding us of the 1945 year, of the history of this place, and the sacrifices of the local soldiers and officers. The most lovely surprise was the amazing forest and…

Cute and nice botanical gardens to enjoy tropical vegetation, butterflies and humming birds (if you can spot them!!!). Wonderful sights of the jungle also, from the mirador. It is free entry and I recommend it if you like to take a nice walk with kids or friends. We enjoyed a wonderful mango juice in the restaurant, don't miss it!!!
When the rain stopped in the afternoon of August 17, 2019, I drove here. Free car parks in front of the free garden. I walked up and had a 180 degree view of Miyako’s tropical forest.

681.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

682.a: Mocktail Story, 1 Chome-11-4 Yatsu, Narashino, Chiba 275-0026, Japan
682.aj: 〒275-0026 千葉県習志野市谷津１丁目１１−４ 台湾茶屋モクテルストーリー(MOCKTAIL STORY) - 津田沼の台湾カフェ・豆花・魯肉飯・タピオカ
catj: タピオカティー専門店
682.ed: Diners like this cafe's authentic Taiwanese dishes, including flavorful Lu Rou Fan and refreshing Douhua with various toppings. They also highlight the wide selection of delicious drinks, such as jasmine milk tea and authentic oolong tea. Guests mention the staff are friendly, kind, and provide warm, attentive service.
682.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、風味豊かなルーローハンや、さまざまなトッピングが楽しめるさっぱりとした豆花など、本格的な台湾料理が高く評価されています。また、ジャスミンミルクティーや本格的な烏龍茶など、豊富な種類の美味しい飲み物も特徴のようです。スタッフは優しく、親切で、温かく丁寧なサービスを提供しているという声が多くあります。

rv.t: good！

Taiwanese tea shop, but also a cozy community. The owner is very friendly and outgoing. Food is authentic Taiwanese, and I love how they have douhua! Seating is limited. It’s a short walk from the train station, so if you’re in the area, drop on by.

偶然見つけました。 ありそうでない台湾デザートのお店。 ・総合豆花6種盛り 小 ・烏龍茶ミルクティーホット 豆花は甘くなく、小でも量がありかなり満足度高いです。タロイモ団子が入っていて嬉しい。完全に台湾のそれでした。 烏龍茶ミルクティーは本当はアイスでタピオカ入れたかったのですが、昼飯食べた後で、寒かったのでホットにしました。 魯肉飯や鶏肉飯がかなり美味しそうだったので、また食べに来たいです。 津田沼でなんちゃってじゃない台湾を味わえるので、貴重なお店でしす。

683.aj: 啓発茶荘 132 Wing Lok St, Sheung Wan, Hong Kong Island, 香港

rv.t: Tea sets are nice but staff are horrendous. We were waiting for our two tea set purchase to be ready. I am pregnant and had severe sciatica that day and could barely walk but needed to change for a wedding after, so asked if I could borrow their bathroom to change. They saw how much pain I was in but told me to use the public toilet across the street. I walked in and used their bathroom out of frustration and there…
I bought some dried natural date. They have seeds but are sweet and very delicious. The staff were very kind, although they didn't speak English.

My daughter gets me tea for birthday surprise, from this place. And turns out this place is a total ripped off for westerners. She paid $2600 for a 150g for tea, and they were broken tea bits. When i pour the bag out, they were like at least 20-30g are tea powder/dusts( more like instant coffee powder). Very bad experience and do not recommend for anyone. Avoid this place!

684.a: Book House Cafe, １階 2 Chome-5-3 Kanda Jinbocho, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 101-0051, Japan
684.aj: 〒101-0051 東京都千代田区神田神保町２丁目５−３ １階 Book House Cafe
684.ed: Coffee, pastries & desserts, plus light eats & wine in a relaxed venue filled with books.
684.edj: コーヒー、ペイストリー、デザート、軽食、ワインを提供する本がたくさん並べられたくつろげるカフェ。

rv.t: Adorable book cafe in the heart of the Jimbocho book neighborhood. English menu is available inside with pictures to those who need it. The dining area is surrounded by a well-stocked children’s book store. Enter, order at the register in the back, pay with card or cash, then take number to your seat. Food and drinks are delivered to your table. WiFi is available. Definitely browse the book selection as they have…

Awesome experience and broughts kids books there! Food: order the Japanese bento, curry bun and kids curry! Kids love the food. Love the good atmosphere and vibes there with kids & parents reading and eating. Will definitely visit again!

This place is good to relax and have coffee ☕️ Accidentally I stopped by and had a good time here. Ice cream was tasty 😋 but coffee not that good. The ambiance of this bookstore and coffee shop was so good 👍

685.a: Roadside Station Itako, 1326-1 Maekawa, Itako, Ibaraki 311-2416, Japan
685.aj: 〒311-2416 茨城県潮来市前川１３２６−１ 道の駅 いたこ
catj: サービスエリア / パーキング エリア
685.ed: Visitors say this roadside station offers a wide variety of fresh local vegetables, unique regional products, and delicious prepared foods like dorayaki and self-serve cafeteria meals. They also highlight the spacious parking, clean restrooms, and convenient location near the Itako Interchange. Other reviews mention the food offerings can be inconsistent.
685.edj: クチコミによると、この道の駅では新鮮な地元野菜や珍しい地域の商品、どら焼きなどの美味しい調理済み食品、セルフサービスの食堂メニューが豊富に揃っていると評判です。また、広々とした駐車場、清潔なトイレ、潮来インターチェンジに近い便利な立地も高く評価されています。 一方で、提供される食事の質にはばらつきがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Our first michi no eki on the way from Tokyo to Oarai. It was large and had many places to get different food. I'd have liked to have more time to look at what they offered inside.
Good road side station with clean toilets and a great shop selling local products. We bought some persimmon, grilled sweet potato, corn and an onigiri.
Great stop alone the coast line between Tokyo and the North. Must go into the supermarket and see the local produce.

686.a: Japan, 〒311-2111 Ibaraki, Hokota, Kamizawa, 1746-4 お肉工房 ３匹のこぶた
686.aj: 〒311-2111 茨城県鉾田市上沢１７４６−４ お肉工房 ３匹のこぶた

rv.t: 初めての利用です、ハムカツ、とんかつ、メンチカツ、コロッケを購入 近隣のスーパーの惣菜より全体的に1.5倍くらいの大きさ値段は倍くらいです ハムカツはかなり肉厚 コロッケはしっとり程よくひき肉 とんかつは肉に甘みがあります メンチカツはふっくらしています 揚げ油もスッキリしてもたれませんでした ついでに味付け豚ハラミ（冷凍）も購入これは後日いただきます 機会があればまた購入したいと思います
揚げ物を買う時は、電話注文を受け付けて下さるので助かっています。いつも揚げ油が新鮮で特にメンチカツはお肉がジューシーでオススメです。３匹のこぶたの揚げ物はレベルが違います！
注文してから揚げたてを購入する事が出来る、種類豊富な惣菜がとても美味しいです。 特に好きなのがコロッケとメンチ。 何度でも食べたくなる大好きな味です。

687.aj: 〒311-1426 茨城県鉾田市樅山６０２−６ ＪＡ茨城旭村 特産物直売所 サングリーン旭

687.ed: Bustling, covered farmers' market showcasing local produce, such as melons, spinach & corn.

rv.t: I visited Hokusata with melons in mind. Facing the main street, there's a place for purchasing melons via card payment or mail. For cash purchases to take home, there's another spot near the melon soft serve counter. I also had melon soft serve. Personally, I prefer melon soft serve with fruit chunks over the half-cut version. The sweetness of the fruit chunks surpasses that of the soft serve. I'd like to come again…
Enough for village
ＯＫ

688.a: Japan, 〒311-2113 Ibaraki, Hokota, Kamihataki, 1521 干しいもの いいじま
688.aj: 〒311-2113 茨城県鉾田市上幡木１５２１ 干しいもの いいじま
688.ed: Visitors say this specialty store offers delicious dried sweet potatoes and baked sweet potatoes, with many highlighting the rich, sweet flavor and creamy texture. They also mention the reasonable prices and the availability of various types, including round and flat dried sweet potatoes. Others appreciate the option for local delivery and the convenience of purchasing gift sets.
688.edj: この専門店を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しい干し芋と焼き芋が高く評価されています。濃厚で甘い風味とクリーミーな食感を挙げる人が多くいます。また、手頃な価格で、丸干しや平干しなど、さまざまな種類の干し芋が手に入るという声もあります。地方発送や贈答品の購入ができる点も喜ばれています。

rv.t: 干し芋LOVER必見の自社栽培の干し芋専門店！ 鹿島灘の潮風が吹き抜ける鉾田の畑。その風景の延長線上にあるのが「干しいものいいじま」。ここは“作って干す”だけじゃない、“育てるところから甘さを設計する”干し芋専門店です。 まず驚くのは、さつまいもを自社農園で育てていること。水はけのいい砂地と、自家製堆肥で整えた土。主役は糖度の高い「紅はるか」。苗の段階から「干したときにどう甘くなるか」まで計算されているんです。 収穫後すぐには干しません。じっくり熟成させて、芋の中のでんぷんを糖へと変える。そこから蒸して、冬の太陽と鹿島灘の潮風に委ねる天日干し。機械では出せない、奥行きのある甘さがゆっくりと育っていきます。 今回頂いたのは、『べにはるかの丸干し』。 今までの干し芋とは全く比べ物にならないくらいねっとり濃密…もはや天然のキャラメル。平干しは、噛むたびに芋の香りがほどけていきます。 派手さはなくても食べた瞬間にでも一口でわかる、…

口コミを見て、旅行のルートとも照らし合わせながら、３軒の芋店で焼き芋を購入しましたが、こちらの店舗で買った焼き芋が、ダントツで美味しかったです。ねっとりとした濃い甘さは、もはやりっぱなスイーツです。デザートとして大満足の商品でした。 干し芋はまだ食べていませんが、とっても楽しみです。 三連休の中日で、9時10分前に到着しましたが、すでに開店していて、他のお客さんもおられました。お買い得の干し芋が買えて、嬉しかったです。 早めの来店をおすすめします。
母親が干し芋が好きで、頼まれて買い付けに行きました(笑) 評価が高くて直近のレビューが1ヶ月以内のお店に絞って突撃してみたのですが…たぶん当たりです🎯😊 道路から少し奥まったお店ですが、ひっきりなしにお客様が来られてて賑わってるのが分かります！ 私自身は干し芋は好んでは食べないので味の評価は母親に食べてもらってからですが、きっと好評に違いありません😊︎︎👍

689.a: Miurakaigan Station, Kamimiyada Minamishitauramachi, Miura, Kanagawa 238-0101, Japan
689.aj: 〒238-0101 神奈川県三浦市南下浦町上宮田 三浦海岸駅

rv.t: Miurakaigan station is the place For an early Cherry blossom 🌸 You’ll be greeted with Kawazu Cherry Blossom right from exit the station until the park for about 1 km long Its a nice view to enjoy and take some photos I was here after mid February so it was really nice

I will not lie, it is a very long walk. BUT it is totally and completely worth it. There’s like 100 cherry trees, a walking trail around a lake with facilities, and plenty of gorgeous spots for a picnic. 😊

It's a good station, albeit a bit old. They have been doing some renovations to make it seem nicer. The bathrooms are old but always clean. I just wish they had a digital ticker showing when the trains are coming, like some of the bigger stations! There are some restaurants and grocery stores, as well as local businesses all around. And you can catch a bus further in the peninsula if needed from here.

690.aj: 〒906-0000 沖縄県宮古島市伊良部大橋
690.ed: Visitors say this bridge offers stunning views of the "Miyako Blue" ocean, with its clear emerald and cobalt waters, and is Japan's longest toll-free bridge. They also highlight the exhilarating feeling of driving over the sea and the opportunity to spot sea turtles, manta rays, and sea snakes. Guests mention that the scenery changes beautifully throughout the day, making it ideal for driving…
690.edj: この橋を利用した人からは、透明なエメラルドグリーンとコバルトブルーの海が広がる「宮古ブルー」の絶景が素晴らしいという声が多く聞かれます。また、日本で最も長い無料の橋であることも特徴です。海の上を走るような爽快なドライブ体験ができることや、運が良ければウミガメ、マンタ、ウミヘビなどが見られることも魅力として挙げられています。一日を通して景色が美しく変化するため、ドライブ、サイクリング、ランニングにも最適という感想があります。

rv.t: Irabu Ohashi Bridge is incredibly long and offers some of the most stunning views of the ocean in Miyakojima. The water below is a beautiful shade of blue and changes color depending on the sunlight and weather, making the drive feel like you're floating above a tropical paradise. There are a few parking spots along the way where you can safely stop, get out, and take photos. Definitely worth doing—some of the best…
There is passing place in the middle of the bridge, can take good photo here, sometimes there are sea turtles swimming
Epic, out-of-this-world place with the feeling of a car literally going up into the beautiful sea of Miyako-jima. You can never get bored crossing this bridge.

691.a: 〒906-0507 沖縄県宮古島市伊良部佐和田 ワンセブンエンド

692.a: 17 END Beach, Sawada Irabu, Miyakojima, Okinawa 906-0507, Japan
692.aj: 〒906-0507 沖縄県宮古島市伊良部佐和田 17END
692.ed: Visitors say this beach offers stunning "Miyako Blue" ocean views with clear, emerald green waters and white sand, especially beautiful at low tide. They also highlight the unique experience of seeing airplanes take off and land up close, recommending checking flight schedules for this. Guests mention the free parking, but advise arriving early as spaces are limited and can fill up quickly.
692.edj: クチコミによると、このビーチからは、透明なエメラルドグリーンの海と白い砂浜が広がる美しい「宮古ブルー」の景色が楽しめると評判です。特に干潮時には、その美しさが際立つという声が多くあります。また、飛行機が間近で離着陸する様子を見られるユニークな体験も高く評価されており、フライトスケジュールを確認していくのがおすすめという意見もあります。無料駐車場はありますが、スペースが限られているため、早めに到着することをおすすめします。

rv.t: Nice area. surrounded by different shades of blue water. You may get down to the beach only when it is low tide make sure you check the flight time as it is better to see the landing of the plane. unfortunately we missed the landing, taking off is not the same.
Just went to look and it's quite a beautiful beach situated next to the airport at the end of the island.
Parking was long wait but worth it! Beautiful beach when you walk in. Can also see the airplanes take off. Recommend if you’re in the island to visit!!

693.a: Torisoba Zagin KITTE Marunouchi, KITTE丸の内 B1F 2 Chome-7-2 Marunouchi, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 100-0005, Japan
693.aj: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内２丁目７−２ KITTE丸の内 B1F 鶏soba 座銀 KITTE丸の内店
693.ed: People say this ramen shop offers a creamy and rich chicken paitan soup, along with unique toppings like crispy fried burdock and tender chicken and pork chashu. They also highlight the delicious seared meat sushi, which pairs perfectly with the ramen. Visitors appreciate the stylish, clean atmosphere and the friendly, attentive staff who provide excellent service.
693.edj: クチコミによると、このラーメン店はクリーミーで濃厚な鶏白湯スープが特徴です。サクサクとした揚げごぼうや、しっとり柔らかい鶏肉と豚肉のチャーシューなど、個性的なトッピングも高く評価されています。また、香ばしく炙られた肉寿司も人気で、ラーメンとの相性が抜群という声が多くあります。店内はスタイリッシュで清潔感があり、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフの丁寧なサービスも、訪れた人々に好評です。

rv.t: What a hidden gem! We loved it so much that we came back two days in a row. The spicy soba was packed with flavor, the original chicken broth soba was rich and comforting, and the beef sushi was absolutely delicious. The crispy burdock added the perfect savory crunch that made every bite even better. Everything was amazing, and we can’t wait to come back!

A really great ramen spot. The lady there was incredibly friendly, and I truly appreciated how welcoming she was. I was a bit hesitant to ask questions since my Japanese isn’t very strong, but she made me feel comfortable and understood. Even though we had already eaten, we still decided to try the ramen, and it was delicious!! The broth had great depth, and the three different kinds of meat were all excellent. They…

Really enjoyed the food here!! Everything tasted high quality and carefully prepared. The combination of the flavorful broth, great texture of the noodles, and incredible pork rice made this one of my favorite meals of the trip. The staff were also friendly and the experience was smooth from start to finish. Definitely recommend if you’re in Tokyo and looking for a great ramen and pork rice. I’ll definitely be back!

693.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

694.a: 395, Cassia Rama 9 Bangkok Hotel, 1063 Rama IX Rd, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand
694.aj: 395, Cassia Rama 9 Bangkok Hotel, 1063 Rama IX Rd, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310 タイ

rv.t: Been staying here quite often, the loation is a bit out. Hotel did provide transport, do check the timing and remember to inform front desk if you are waiting for the transport.This time round there are quite a bit of changes with the hotel. More F&B available that make it easy for everyone that staying here and 24hr Lawson shop. As for the room, good and bad for moving the bed down. If decide to place the bed at…

Positive: I really enjoyed my stay in room #3517. The duplex layout makes the room feel incredibly spacious, and the amenities are top-notch—everything felt clean and brand new. The breakfast is a great value for the price, and I appreciated the spacious seating layout in the dining area. ​Considerations: Prospective guests should note the location is right next to a tollway gate, so the area isn't walkable for…

Mint and Gam are honestly some of the kindest and most welcoming people I’ve ever met. They made the whole stay feel special from the very beginning. The hotel was amazing — beautiful rooms, great atmosphere, perfect service, and everything was always clean and comfortable. You can really feel that the staff care about the guests. I had such a wonderful experience and I would definitely love to come back again…

695.a: Tokinoyu Setsugetsuka, 1300-34 Gora, Hakone, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa 250-0408, Japan
695.aj: 〒250-0408 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町強羅１３００−３４ 季の湯 雪月花
695.ed: Minimalist rooms in a modern inn featuring a restaurant & hot spring baths, plus a garden.
695.edj: クチコミによると、このホテルは貸し切り風呂や大浴場など、さまざまな温泉を楽しめるようです。食事は美味しい和食の朝食と夕食が提供され、強羅駅からのアクセスも良く、お菓子やアイス、夜食のラーメンといった無料サービスも充実していると評価されています。 一方で、部屋のメンテナンスが行き届いていないという声もあります。

rv.t: We stayed here for 3 days and 2 nights with full board (breakfast and dinner included), and overall it was a memorable experience with a few trade-offs. Highlights: - The ryokan offers a wide range of thoughtful amenities and services that really add value to the stay. We especially enjoyed the snack bar, the midnight ramen offering, and the option to borrow kimono and pyjamas, it made the experience feel special…

The hotel is conveniently located next to Gora Station & bus stops, which is of great help to us as we arrived on a rainy day. The hotel environment is quiet and comfortable, which provides a sense of relaxation.Key highlight is the onsen – the different hot springs are thoughtfully designed, with unique characteristics for both indoor and outdoor options. Too bad, we didn’t get to enjoy the private onsens as they…

The most relaxing stay - we wished we stayed 2 nights! We loved the open air bath included with the room and also enjoyed the various private onsens (no booking required). Photos do not do this place justice - it is an oasis. There were many amenities including free snacks, soba, kimono rentals, etc. I had the best massage as well! It was our birthday/honeymoon trip and we were so appreciative of the surprise…

696.a: Japan, 〒101-0045 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Kanda Kajicho, 3 Chome−3 New Kanda Building, 地下１階 魚匠屋 神田本店
696.aj: 〒101-0045 東京都千代田区神田鍛冶町３丁目３ ニュー神田ビル 地下１階 魚匠屋 神田本店
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
696.ed: Diners like this restaurant's generous portions of fresh seafood bowls, especially the "kaisen mizore don," and appreciate the option to enjoy it three ways, including as ochazuke. They also highlight the excellent value, free rice and dashi refills, and the friendly, attentive staff. Other reviews mention the seafood can be flavorless.
696.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、新鮮な海鮮丼のボリュームと、特にマグロの美味しさが高く評価されています。また、無料で提供される出汁を使ってお茶漬けにするなど、三通りの食べ方を楽しめる点も好評です。手頃な価格設定、丁寧なスタッフの対応、クレジットカードやPayPayでの支払いが可能な点も、多くのユーザーに喜ばれています。 一方で、海鮮の味が物足りないという意見や、味が薄いというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Great izakaya mostly serving fish. We went here with colleagues and got the private room with the 5,000 yen course. Food was really tasty and big portions. Drinks came quickly (you order on your phone), and they also had many nihonshu included in the plan.
good japanese cuisines at KANDA area. manykind of sakes are enjoyable. prices are reasonable enough.
ランチでたっぷり海鮮みぞれ丼をいただきました。 海鮮丼としても美味しいですし、ご飯をおかわりしてのだし茶漬けも美味しかったです。 おかわりご飯も食べ放題とのことなので、満足度も高くかなりコストパフォーマンスも良いと思います。 お酒も充実しているのでまた夜に伺ってみたいと思うお店です。

696.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

697.a: Japan, 〒420-0852 Shizuoka, Aoi Ward, Koyamachi, 5−2 旬菜旬魚 造りの山葵
697.aj: 〒420-0852 静岡県静岡市葵区紺屋町５−２ 旬菜旬魚 造りの山葵
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店

rv.t: We went there with a reservation on a Saturday in April. All the staff are really friendly and also talkative, I found that quiet outstanding. Of course there is lots of wasabi related dishes - just as the name promises. We had fish, sashimi, soba, salad and meat - everything was tasty and of excellent quality. We will surely come back the next time we’re in Shizuoka.

Restaurant is called Wasabi and looks newly renovated. The food and service was excellent. We had a mix of sashimi, nigiri, wagyu beef, and tempura, plus some other interesting dishes such as wasabi root sushi roll and a fried tofu salad that was simply divine. The menu was in Japanese but we used google translate camera to read and the waiter was helpful. Highly recommend.

Sushi I ate: 1,700 yen . The money I paid: 3,200 yen.Jotgatta It is expensive. I was disappointed. If you sit down, you pay 500 yen for a seat, and you have to pay 500 yen more, even if you haven't ordered a side dish. And even if you don't want it, the staff is asking you to order a drink that costs about 500 yen.

698.a: Japan, 〒870-0021 Oita, Funaimachi, 2 Chome−4−7 魚河岸
698.aj: 〒870-0021 大分県大分市府内町２丁目４−７ 魚河岸

rv.t: 大分市府内町にある居酒屋さん。 いかにも居酒屋な雰囲気の店内で大分名物のりゅうきゅうやとり天が頂けます。どれも美味しくてアルコールが進みますよ。特に鯛皮の肝和えがものすごく美味しかった。鯛の肝はあん肝のような味で鯛皮のコリコリとした食感とよく合います。お店の方もとてもサービスが良く夜の大分の魅力にすっかり取りつかれてしまいました。

【魚河岸】さん #魚河岸 ・もずく ・琉球 ・トマトスライス ・蕗のとう天ぷら ・あじフライ ・いか下足天ぷら まずはビールでお疲れ生です🍺 かなり調子良く頼んでしまい腹パンに。 ビールからの〜焼酎へ移行！ 焼酎キープがあると言うので頂く💚 どれもこれもお得な金額で美味しくて おススメです。 名物の手羽先や餃子は売り切れだったので 運よければ食べられるねん♬ ごちそうさまでした！ ꉂꉂ (*ˊᗜˋ*)
ふらっと立ち寄った昔風な雰囲気の店。酒放浪記に出てきそうな店。刺身は鮮度が良く、初めて食べた関サバは美味い！と唸ってしまった。シニア世代なら長居してしまうかも。当たりの店でした。

698.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

699.a: Sharin Marunouchi Branch, Marunouchi Eiraku Building, Ｂ１ 1 Chome-4-1 Marunouchi, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 100-0005, Japan
699.aj: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内１丁目４−１ 丸の内永楽ビルディング Ｂ１ 舎鈴 丸の内店
699.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious tsukemen with thick, chewy noodles and rich, flavorful seafood-pork broth, along with a variety of toppings and seasonings for customization. They also highlight the reasonable prices, efficient service, and quick turnaround, making it ideal for a fast and satisfying meal. Other reviews mention the noodles can be lukewarm.
699.edj: このラーメン店を利用したユーザーは、もちもちとした太麺と魚介豚骨の濃厚なスープが特徴のつけ麺を高く評価しています。様々なトッピングや調味料で自分好みにカスタマイズできる点も好評です。また、手頃な価格、効率的なサービス、提供の早さも、手早く満足のいく食事をしたい場合に理想的だと評価されています。 一方で、麺がぬるいというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: In the relentless concrete grid of Otemachi, where the air hums with corporate urgency and asphalt radiates a ceaseless summer heat, Sharin offers a rare and radical intervention: absolute, calculated chill. To order the chilled hhiyakake ramen here is to step momentarily outside the city’s thermodynamic cycle. The moment the cool, translucent soup touches the palate, a profound clarity takes over. Unlike a hot…

Been here twice already and I always order the tantan tsukemen, as recommended by my colleague. The spice level is Japanese-style spicy, if you know what I mean. The soup is savory and delicious, though it doesn’t have a huge wow factor. That said, the cost-performance is high, so I’d definitely come back again, especially on rainy days

A local recommended this dipping noodle place. Food: 5/5 - you order prior to being seated. There were 4 different sizes of noodles to choose from. You can purchase extra toppings. We had the foundation dip noodle with pork and the Dan-dan spicy noodle with a side of egg and spinach. The portions were bigger than expected. They also offer extra stock to add to your soup. Service: 5/5 - server was nice and friendly…

699.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

rv.t: Pretty good
町の割烹屋 駐車場は店の横で指定されている 店内はカウンターとテーブルと奥の部屋もあって広い メニューは豊富で海鮮類がメインである 三崎直送まぐろ漬丼を注文した 注文はＱＲコードをスマホから読み取って出来るが直接口頭でも出来るメンドクサイので口頭で言ったほうが早いマグロは新鮮で味わい良く旨かった。

熱燗を頼んで飲んでて、4本目にきた酒が何故かしょっぱい。 店員を呼んで「この酒しょっぱいけど料理酒じゃないのか？」って聞いたら、「確認します」と一旦厨房へ。 その後、責任者と名乗る男がやってきて、何も言わずに徳利を置く。 こちらから「さっきの酒は何？」と聞くと、なんとこの責任者は謝罪もなく「食洗器で洗って次亜塩素酸ナトリウムが底に溜まって残ってた、だからしょっぱい」と。 こちら側一同ぽかーん。。。 じあえんそさんなとりうむ？？？それ消毒液じゃん！ 完全に保健所案件、食品衛生上あり得ないですね。 「料理酒じゃないのか？」って再度質問すると、「うちは料理酒使ってない」と。 最終的に責任者と名乗る男の母親（持ち帰った店員）が来て、「私が間違えて料理酒注ぎました」と。 さっきの嘘つき責任者からの説明を求めるると、「じゃあどうすればいいんですか！？ただにしろってことか！」と潔く逆切れ。…

Good food. Reasonable price. No smoking.
Small but fine

702.a: Kobo no Satoyu, 3 Chome-1-2 Tsurumakikita, Hadano, Kanagawa 257-0001, Japan

702.ed: Relaxed, daytime establishment featuring a natural hot spring for soaking, a foot bath & restaurant.
702.edj: くつろげる日帰りの天然温泉施設。浴場、足湯、食事処がある。

rv.t: Paid 1000 jpy and had a time limit of 2 hours which was more than enough. There were signs that say no tattoos allowed. The women’s had an outdoor pool, an indoor pool and a sauna. Towels can be bought at the counter outside. No lotions or toiletries provided, only the standard shampoo/shower gel, hairdryer and water fountain. Perfect after a hike nearby, we went after completing our hike at Ōyama. They also had a…

Nice onsen (sento) which is very near to the station. Amenities (like oil, cream) is not there so better bring your own & Towel (220¥) too. Temperature of the water was around at 40C Sauna is the advantage here!

Great supersento very close to the station so very convenient for hikers and cyclists after a long day out in nature. Yo my memory only 1 rotenburo and you only get I think 2 hours to stay. Which is enough in most cases but isn’t very common to have a timed entry. No rental towels.

703.aj: 〒310-0905 茨城県水戸市石川２丁目４０６７ Hanare 萬乃蔵

rv.t: 大谷石の蔵をリノベーションしておしゃれなお店がオープンしていると言うのでお伺いしました。 予約の方がほとんどで、予約してなくても2人なら大丈夫と言う事で席に着けました。 ガレット又はピザとデザートで1200円で、飲み物追加でも300円でした。 デザートは追加料金でパフェにもなります。 自分は季節のピザを相方はガレットを注文しました。 具材はオーナー自ら栽培している物で料理してあるらしく、珍しいフルーツピーマンやズッキーニなどがいっぱい使われていて味は満足、更にデザートにはアイスなどおしゃれに盛りつけされていて量的にもちょうど良いと思います。 しかし今回もまた男性は自分1人でまわりは全て女性の方々で隠れ家的お店なので予約をおすすめします。 開店と同時に席が埋まる状態で全て女性の方で男性の方は彼女とのデートで行くと喜ばれると思います
バターナッツのガレットいただきました。 店の雰囲気がとにかく好み。ガレットも申し分なく美味しい。しかもデザートで付いてくるワッフルも最高。 そしてあの量で1200円は安い。 駅からはやや遠いが行くべきお店。

古民家リノベーションのman’s cafeの姉妹店。 蔵をリノベーションして自家製のお野菜を提供で、1200円でしっかりたっぷりとデザートもいただけます。 石造りの蔵だから涼しくて穏やかなBGM、シンプルで品のあるアンティーク調のインテリアが素敵でした。 開店時間には駐車場があっという間にいっぱいになりますので予約をお勧めします。 写真は、舞茸のガレットとピザマルゲリータ。 どちらも玄米の生地でミニサラダとデザート付。 デザートはワッフル・アフォガード付き、写真撮るのを忘れました。美味しくてすごく満足でした(^ ^)

704.a: Japan, 〒310-0912 Ibaraki, Mito, Migawa, 5 Chome−114 むぎとろ古民家 すず
704.aj: 〒310-0912 茨城県水戸市見川５丁目１１４ むぎとろ古民家 すず
704.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and satisfying set meals, especially the creamy tororo and freshly fried tempura, with many appreciating the free rice refills. They also highlight the warm, inviting atmosphere of the renovated traditional house and the attentive, polite staff. Guests mention that making a reservation is recommended due to its popularity.
704.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーは、美味しくて満足感のある定食、特にクリーミーなとろろや揚げたての天ぷらを高く評価しています。ご飯のおかわりが無料な点も喜ばれています。また、改装された古民家の温かく居心地の良い雰囲気や、丁寧で親切なスタッフの対応も好評です。人気があるため、予約をしてから訪れることをおすすめするクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: 2026.3.8再訪。 本日の麦とろ御膳をいただきました。 11:30に電話して13:00の予約で入店しました。人気店のようでお昼はほぼ満席でした。 古民家の落ち着いた雰囲気でゆっくり食事ができます。 麦ご飯ととろろの相性がとても良く、小鉢や茶碗蒸しも付いていて満足感がありました。 来訪日：2025年7月26日 本日の麦とろ御膳（1980円）をいただきました。笠間産の自然薯を使用したとろろは、粘りが強く風味豊か。7月に採れたての石垣島産のお米は、やや硬めでとろろとの相性も良く、食が進みます。ご飯はおかわり自由というのも嬉しいポイントです。 女性スタッフの接客は丁寧で、気配りも感じられました。ランチは3種類あり、現金のみでテーブル会計というスタイル。古民家を改装した店内は、外観こそ古さを残していますが、中は清潔感があり、ジャズが流れる心地よい空間。若い女性客にも好まれそうな雰囲気でした。…
とっても美味しいトロロだった！ 上司がランチに連れてきてくれた！ ここなら彼のお母さんも連れて行ってあげたいなと思った⸜( ´ ꒳ ` )⸝♡︎ 天ぷらも揚げたてでおいしくて、 ほんとに満腹！！ 家では食べられないちゃんとしたこだわりの むぎとろ！雰囲気も古民家で素敵だった！
とろろがとても滑らか。おそらくすり鉢の壁を使って丁寧に摺ってると思われ。大根おろしとか使って横着したらこんなにきめ細かにならない。 接客は丁寧で、アレルギーなどにも配慮してくれる。 ご飯のおかわり自由も嬉しい。 天ぷら御膳を頂いたが、野菜中心でとてもヘルシーなので、罪悪感0でお変わり可能（当社比（笑））。

705.a: Japan, 〒894-0102 Kagoshima, Oshima District, Tatsugo, Sedome, 967 龍郷町保健福祉センター・どぅくさぁや館
705.aj: 〒894-0102 鹿児島県大島郡龍郷町瀬留９６７ 龍郷町保健福祉センター・どぅくさぁや館
catj: コミュニティ センター

rv.t: 道沿いのきれいな方ではなく、奥の建物です。施設の感じは星１つですが、旅の途中でお風呂に入れるという意味で星３つです。
昼の１時から開く温泉です、シャンプー石鹸は無いので持って行きましょう、タオルは買う事が出来ます、広いお風呂です。

奄美の中心名瀬と空港の中間にあり、アクセスも良い。町外の人も65歳未満500円、65歳以上300円とリ-ズナブル。平日でも13時から入浴できとても便利。サウナ、水風呂もあり、施設としては平均より優。ただ、客のマナーが全国平均の下位では。男風呂でも洗い場の場所取りが凄い。洗い場の前にシャンプー等風呂道具を綺麗に並べて、女性の化粧台と見間違える強者も。シャワーも5m 位飛ばして、ゆっくり浴槽に居れないことも多々。体を洗わず、いきなり湯船も。せっかくの施設が泣いているかも。

706.a: Aurora Village, Cassidy Point, Yellowknife, NT X1A 2P4, Canada
706.aj: Aurora Village, Cassidy Point, Yellowknife, NT X1A 2P4 カナダ

rv.t: Excellent location, great facilities and an unforgettable experience! I visited Aurora Village over 4 nights in mid-March, and every single night was treated to incredibly vivid aurora displays. Teepees are comfortable and warm for resting in and thawing out after spending time outside looking at the Northern Lights in the cold - and delicious hot chocolate is to be had whenever you want! The restaurant/cafeteria on…

We visited Aurora Village from Taiwan for their famous dog sledding and Aurora experience. As probably the largest site in Yellowknife, it offers some truly iconic views. The Highlights: We were lucky to experience the clearest sky since Jan 1st. Watching the Aurora dancing above the glowing Teepees was magical—a sight so beautiful we stopped trying to catch it on camera and just enjoyed it with our eyes. I also…

An excellent spot for watching Northern light. The heated teepee was good to hide and warm up before going outside again to see the amazing light. They have proper flush toilet in the restaurant building. They also have lighted pathway to different higher point for better photos. Absolutely amazing experience. Of course, it depends on your luck to see Northern light as you don't see it every night.

707.a: Seoul Museum of History, 55 Saemunan-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea
707.aj: ソウル歴史博物館 ５５ Saemunan-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, 韓国
707.ed: Museum on the history of Seoul from prehistoric times to the present, with temporary exhibits.
707.edj: 先史時代から現代までのソウルの歴史を展示する博物館。企画展も行う。

rv.t: This museum is an absolute hidden gem and a must-visit if you want to understand the history of Seoul! Unlike the massive national museums, this one focuses specifically on how the city of Seoul evolved over time. The interactive exhibits are amazing, and the absolute highlight is the massive miniature model room of the city—it is incredible to see how detailed it is from above! Plus, general admission is completely…

I had no idea such a peaceful green space was hidden in the middle of the city. The front garden was lush, tranquil, and a wonderful place to slow down for a while. There happened to be a fun event during my visit, so I completed the activities, looked around, and even picked up a few souvenirs. This time I only explored the outdoor area, but it was enough to make me want to come back and visit the museum itself…

Visited this musuem towards the end of my trip and it was a really good summary of all the history and palaces combined. Very informative and moved through 4 zones to understand the formation of ROK. Highly recommended to come and it will consolidate your understanding of the history proper. Be prepared to spend 3-4 hours if interested in the history itself.

rv.t: Despite not being listed as a major tourist attraction nor being located near the most touristic parts of Seoul, I visited this museum and rather enjoyed it. It's actually smaller than I imagined it to be, so don't expect to spend any more than 30 min to one hour to have a look at everything there. Free entrance, and exhibition guides and videos were translated into English.

Well the facilities are great. Each floor has space for individual artist to showcase their art. The roof has a nice garden. The field surrounding the museum is good for kids. The art inside... well it's contemporary. Not bad place and it's free. The free lockers are nice and bathrooms are sparkly clean. Staff are friendly. I took a star away because the art was eehh. I feel like some exhibits portrayed nothing of…

This one is way out there in the northern reaches of the city. But worth the trip, I suppose. Like all of the SEMA facilities the art tends towards the avant-garde. It is a pretty big spot, so you might be able to spend a few hours. Also check out the library on the top floor. It has a ton of books (non-circulating) about art in both English and Korean.

It was busy but the gallery handles crowds well. They have an excellent gift store, very good book store and a good craft gift store.

A great museum is well-organized and very comfortable to visit. We saw the Damien Hirst exhibition, as well as works by Korean artists. Everything was modern and genuinely interesting. There was a queue for the Hirst exhibition, but it was absolutely worth the wait. It’s also worth noting that admission for children is free, which is a very nice bonus. The museum shop is excellent, it has several sections and a very…

I visited the Damien Hirst exhibition at National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Seoul. Since I went on a holiday, the museum was extremely crowded, but the exhibition was absolutely worth it and full of impressive works. I was especially excited to finally see some of Damien Hirst’s iconic pieces in person. Seeing the details and scale of the artworks up close was an unforgettable experience. I had to wait…

rv.t: A fab little cocktail bar in Seoul. This was on my list of must-visit places in Seoul haha and I managed to get a seat there on my last night (book ahead coz they get quite busy). They’ve divided South Korea into 6 regions based on flavour and their drinks celebrate the produce of each region. The gimbap based cocktail actually smelled like a gimbap! The team is really welcoming, the music just the right volume, the…

Amazing drinks —but what made them even better were the people. 💓 Huge shoutout to Happy for her amazing energy and the ❤️‍🔥 cocktails she made. Also, the manager was just as warm and welcoming, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. So happy they accepted walk in and so glad to experience this place. Thank you ❤️

We waited for over 3 hours on a weekday. Recommend you get tickets first then dine and chill nearby while you wait. As when its your number they expect you to be there within 15mins. Top Asia 50 bar thus many locals and tourists here, the bartender were all very welcoming and explained the menu and concept of the bar to us in english. Korean infused cocktails, definitely would say they have a unique style of pairing…

712.ed: Reviewers praise this cafe for its delicious specialty coffee, including excellent cappuccino and espresso, and its minimalist space that is ideal for solo visitors. Other reviews mention service can be impolite and the atmosphere can be tense.
712.edj: クチコミによると、このカフェは美味しいスペシャルティコーヒーが高く評価されており、特にカプチーノやエスプレッソが素晴らしいという声が多くあります。また、一人でも利用しやすいミニマルな空間も好評です。 一方で、店員の対応が丁寧でない、雰囲気が張り詰めているというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: We love coffee and it was wonderful to find some really good espresso near where we were staying. Mei is really friendly and gave us some recommendations for our trip here. We are very grateful ! Brad and Ella.

A nice cafe thats got a relaxing atmosphere. It's my regular spot to get take away coffee and is always consistent and delicious. The usual is a cappuccino, but the ice latte is also great in the hot and humid weather. The barista is passionate about his coffee and the staff are friendly. It's not your typical cookie cutter franchise like Starbucks and only slightly more expensive for a real, proper coffee. Worth it.

Dear All, One of my spots here in Tokyo. As usual is very nice to stop by randomly for getting my cafe latte. Started to got there more than 4 years ago for sure i will keep coming✌✌. The 2 guys who run the place are always friendly. Please if you are around stop by and try the Gin coffee... It worth it 😎😎. Really good selection for coffee beans. You can find/ buy "Prolog" beans's selection

713.ed: Upscale hot spring inn with a spa, a garden & outdoor soaking tubs, plus a free bus station shuttle.
713.edj: スパ、庭園、露天風呂を備えた高級温泉旅館。バス停までの無料シャトルあり。

rv.t: I have visited many ryokan and accommodations throughout Japan, but I have never experienced anything quite like this place. It can truly be described as the best. The kaiseki cuisine is on another level, and the room condition, onsen, and overall dining experience were all exceptional—so much so that I would give it five stars twice over. It was an overwhelmingly impressive experience. It remains the most memorable…

This is my second/third favourite ryokan. It is old fashioned and rustic but beautifully organised, our room onsen was just gorgeous and the largest outdoor onsen also with breathtaking scenery. We had our dinner served in our room by Moto San who was very kind with great sense of humour, you do not get that kind of individual attention in most places now. So we were happy and grateful for the excellent care and…

Next level ryokan experience. 😍 Staff were friendly and helpful. The room was absolutely delightful with stunning open air bath in the bamboo forest. Meals were thoughtful and exquisitely presented. We had a relaxing and restorative stay and even though it rained, the cool, wet weather just added to the atmosphere.

714.a: smokeworks, サンライズ小池 B1 1 Chome-24-13 Umegaoka, Setagaya City, Tokyo 154-0022, Japan
714.aj: 〒154-0022 東京都世田谷区梅丘１丁目２４−１３ サンライズ小池 B1 SMOKE WORKS TOKYO（スモークワークス）

rv.t: Beautiful, lowkey place for a light meal and smoked produce. Highly recommend their smoked caramel nuts and smoked pudding! The smoked pudding especially is super unique and the smoky caramel offsets the sweetness of the pudding really well. Staff are very friendly too. They have a good range of smoked produce like cheeses, nuts and cold meats, so it’s a great place to pick up a gift or party snack! They have new…

This was my second time coming here, and I decided to try the smoked pudding—even though I’m usually not into pudding at all. Honestly, it blew me away. It was super smooth with this really nice smoky flavor that somehow just works. Hands down the best pudding I’ve ever had! Excited to try their other smoked products next time!

I came here for a late lunch. I got the ham sandwich, smoked pudding, and royal milk tea. The sandwich was well seasoned with great mustard and pickles, with a small side of carrot slaw. The pudding was the star of the visit, Japanese pudding can just be too sweet, but the smoked flavour added a great variety in flavor to the creamy sweet pudding. The royal milk tea was well made. My drink came with a small sample…

715.aj: 〒140-0001 東京都品川区北品川２丁目３０−２８ 荏原神社
715.ed: Visitors say this shrine features impressive, detailed carvings, including powerful dragon gods on the roof and a smiling Ebisu statue, and is especially beautiful during the early cherry blossom season. They also highlight the quiet, peaceful atmosphere and the well-maintained grounds. Some reviews mention the staff can be unavailable.
715.edj: この神社を訪れた人によると、屋根の力強い龍神様や、笑顔の恵比寿様の像など、精巧で細やかな彫刻が印象的で、特に早咲きの桜の時期は美しいというクチコミが多くあります。また、静かで穏やかな雰囲気と手入れの行き届いた境内も高く評価されています。 一部のクチコミでは、スタッフが不在の場合があるという意見もあります。

rv.t: Small shrine with early blooming variety of cherry blossoms. I went late January, and the trees are all blooming already. There was a small crowd of locals and tourists taking pictures of the blossoms when I went in the afternoon. It’s in the middle of train stations, you have to walk around 15 minutes to get here, but it’s a nice walk and good to look around the neighborhood and get a slice of life experience.

I came here on February 23rd, 2025 and the Sakura is already in full-bloomed. I think there is no nearest train station from this shrine (I don't know about bus), but you can easily enjoy your walking session either from Tennozu Isle Station (Rinkai Line) or Shinagawa Station (JR Yamanote Line). For me, I was coming from Tennozu Isle Station then walk all the way to Shinagawa Station. You can enjoy the authentic…

It’s a little shrine that is located in the south of shinagawa. The exit according to google is from south side exit and walk about 5 minutes. But I saw two people carrying their big suitcases coming down stairways two times. If you have a suitcase try north side. I did that on my way back. As of shrine it’s quiet and only local people showed up and paid their respects. And I only saw two Sakura trees but they were…

rv.t: 【紫陽花の海に、人の波】 We stopped by Yokohama English Garden to see the hydrangeas, hoping for a quiet seasonal escape, but the visit felt more crowded than calming. The flowers themselves were beautiful—soft blues, purples, and whites layered like a watercolor garden—but the overall experience was not very memorable. We visited on a Saturday during peak hydrangea season, which was probably the main issue. Despite the fairly…
Visiting the garden to see roses, I felt like the season had ended. Whether the roses will bloom again is uncertain, but currently, the hydrangeas and lilies are making the garden look beautiful.
This was a last minute find while in Yokahama. This garden is gorgeous. I highly recommend it if you like roses. There were so many varieties.

The place works pretty much like the late location of yutenji with the lively owner doing everything by herself (cooking, taking orders, checking the line, charging etc etc) and lines for up a bit before the place opens so be prepared to stay in line. By the…

Amazing restaurant!! The food was divine, and very well presented. We had the quiche (asparagus and lentils), the soramame cold soup and the cheese bread. Absolutely everything was delightful. And the lemonade was the same. Be sure to arrive on time or a bit earlier as there are only 4 tables and it gets packed early.
Great, cosy brunch and lunch spot. Tasty homemade sandwiches, soups and other delights. Owner hustling and working hard to seat customers, take orders, cook and serve.

rv.t: My eggplant gratin with red wine were wonderful spark to end the day Staff was very polite. They also have English menu
Really tasty dishes and very close to yoyogi park. There are several dishes to choose from and very hard to do as they all look amazing! Highly recommended place if you're in the area.

A variety of doria and gratin dishes... It's really good to have such an alternative choice for a weekend supper outing. No full mark in any parts of my first visit but overall my doria experience went fine comfortably.
